title: Describe a trend
description: Practise describing change and reporting findings.

items.targetText: Remote work has gradually become a major trend.
A clear shift towards hybrid models has been reported.

items.prompt: Describe one social or workplace trend in three sentences.
items.promptIt: Descrivi una tendenza sociale o lavorativa in tre frasi.
items.exampleAnswer: Online shopping has become a major trend. Spending has gradually increased. A clear shift towards digital payments has been reported.
items.hint: Use trend, gradually, and has been reported
